description: Prepare a spatial CHT heatmap from CSV x_mm,y_mm,width_mm,height_mm,power_W and a verified mesh zone. Coordinates are lower-left in-plane millimeters; power is total watts per rectangle, never W/m². Specify receiving solid, plane axis/position and tolerance. Returns thermal.surface_heat_sources in meters, preserving the distribution for Fluxcore; no zone averaging or compute. The solver still checks full exterior-face coverage. Remove replaced sources to avoid double heating; do not infer numeric loads from image colors.

inputSchema.description: CSV rectangles are lower-left coordinates in the two in-plane axes, in XYZ order.

name: prepare_surface_heatmap
title: Prepare surface heatmap
